name: World Bank US & EU Gross Domestic Product (GDP)
description: Annual Gross Domestic Product in current US dollars (Indicator NY.GDP.MKTP.CD) for the US and European Union from the World Bank Open Data API.

etl.script: WITH records AS (SELECT UNNEST(from_json(json, '[{"date": "VARCHAR", "value": "DOUBLE"}]')) AS r FROM read_json_auto('http://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/US;EU/indicator/NY.GDP.MKTP.CD?format=json&per_page=1000') WHERE json LIKE '[%') SELECT CAST(strptime(r.date, '%Y') AS TIMESTAMP) AS date, CAST(r.value AS FLOAT64) AS gdp_usd FROM records WHERE r.value IS NOT NULL;
